# CurlingZone

> > Canada's comprehensive curling platform featuring event management, team rankings, player profiles, and fantasy curling games.

CurlingZone.com serves as the central hub for Canadian curling, providing tools for event organizers, detailed statistics and rankings for men's, women's, and mixed doubles teams, and interactive fantasy games for fans. The platform tracks players like Peter Cameron, Phillip Hamilton, and Owen Carry across tournaments and maintains the Canadian Team Ranking System.

## Key Topics

- Event Management System
- Canadian Team Ranking System
- Player Profiles & Statistics
- Fantasy Curling
- Men's Curling
- Women's Curling
- Mixed Doubles
- Event Calendar
- Team Stats & History
- Curling Tournaments
- Live Scores
- Playoff Predictions

## Event Management

- [Event Management System @ CurlingZone.com](https://events.curlingzone.com): Event management system for curling events with login and calendar access
- [Event Management Homepage](https://events.curlingzone.com/index.php): Event management homepage with calendar navigation and login portal

## Rankings & Player Data

- [Canadian Team Rankings](https://curlingzone.com/rankings.php): Canadian Team Ranking System for men's, women's, and mixed doubles curling
- [Player Profiles](https://curlingzone.com/player.php): Player profiles with teams, stats, photos, videos, and event history

## Fantasy Curling

- [Fantasy Curling Game](https://curlingzone.com/fantasy/game.php): Fantasy curling game with picks, tiebreakers, and playoff predictions
